lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters (approximate diameter 25-40px) arranged in vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit, extending into the mid-body region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a defined grid pattern along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature in the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple high-contrast elongated features (consistent with remoras) are visible in the ventral space below the pectoral fin and along the lower flank.
